avis.titre: My Makeup Has Never Looked This Glowy
avis.texte: I've been using the d'Alba First Spray Serum both before and after makeup, and it has become a staple in my routine. The ultra-fine mist feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin a healthy, radiant glow without feeling greasy. It instantly takes away that dry, powdery look and makes my makeup look much more natural. I also love using it throughout the day for a quick refresh. If you're after hydrated, glowing skin, this is definitely worth trying.

The two layers you shake together is the whole point an essence phase (water, humectants) pulls moisture into skin, and an oil phase (avocado, sunflower, meadowfoam) locks it in. Trufferol (white truffle + tocopherol) is the antioxidant core, vitamin E paired with truffle extract to defend against the environmental stress that ages and dulls skin, while supporting elasticity. Niacinamide sits high on the list, real support for barrier and tone. The ultra-fine spray is functional, a fine enough droplet settles through makeup without disturbing it, which is how it refreshes a made-up face instead of streaking it. Humectants (hydroxyethyl urea, hyaluronic acid, betaine) do the water-binding, pulling and holding moisture so the glow is hydration, not shine. Best for dry, dull, dehydrated skin, midday makeup refresh, on-the-go glow.

I've been reaching for the d'Alba First Spray Serum whenever my makeup starts looking a little dry or powdery. The ultra-fine mist feels incredibly lightweight, instantly refreshes my skin, and gives me a natural, healthy glow without feeling greasy. It leaves my makeup looking smoother and my skin feeling hydrated, making it an easy step in my daily routine.

avis.titre: Wonderful product for my skincare routine
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from BuzzAgent in exchange for my honest review, and I'm so impressed with the d'Alba White Truffle First Spray Serum! This product has quickly become a favorite in my skincare routine. It delivers an instant boost of hydration and leaves my skin looking fresh, radiant, and healthy. The mist is ultra-fine and sprays evenly, making it perfect to use before makeup, after cleansing, or anytime my skin needs a refresh throughout the day. It feels lightweight, absorbs beautifully, and never leaves a sticky or greasy residue. I also love the luxurious feel of the formula. My skin feels softer, smoother, and more nourished after each use. The glow it gives is natural and dewy without looking oily. The packaging is sleek and elegant, and the bottle feels high quality. Overall, this serum mist is a wonderful combination of hydration, convenience, and radiance. If you're looking for a skincare product that instantly refreshes and gives your skin a healthy glow, I highly recommend trying the d'Alba White Truffle First Spray Serum!
The scent is great and it hydrates the skin! Use it after cleansing or after makeup and makes my skin glow.

Overall, it's my quick go-to when my skin needs a fresh, healthy glow.

This spray serum was just what I needed to hydrate my very dry post winter skin. I tend to be very lazy with face moisturizers post shower so my skin dries out fast during the colder months. I have oily skin so I did worry about looking greasy, but this spray serum is not heavy at all. A bit of fragrance. but I still liked the serum spray. Overall, I do like this product and I would recommend. I will try wearing this serum spray under my every day makeup and will circle back. For now, this serum spray will be purchased again. Receive this product in exchange for review*

It smells good and dries so quickly you have to wonder if there's actual liquid in the bottle or what. No negative effects. Maybe my skin is a bit brighter? Hard to say. It's fine. I'm not even sure what it's supposed to do, but whatever it is, it's competent at best. I think.

This serum provides an instant refresh and lift to my skin. If you feel like your skin is dull, dry, or just less vibrant, give it a try! It will restore the bouncy radiance to your skin. The scent is light and pleasant, nothing remarkable, a bit floral. I didn't feel like it was too intense. The hydrating effect on my skin lasted quite a while. I would absolutely purchase this again and again. My skin in naturally oily, but has been lacking a glow - instead it has an oily shine. This helped everything feel balanced and radiant. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
Really love how it leave mt face feeling after i clean my face really enjoy how it feels and love everythinf about it reallt make my face fresh
I loved the refreshing feeling of the spray. It gave my skin good hydration. It has a scent but it's not overwhelming at all. Overall I loved a easy spray step to my skin care.

This spray serum is a nice, lightweight option for adding quick hydration. The mist is fine and easy to apply, and it leaves the skin feeling refreshed with a subtle glow. It works well both before and after makeup for a simple boost. The only downside is that it doesn't feel deeply moisturizing on its own, so I still need to layer it with other products. Overall, it's a good addition to a routine, just not a standalone serum.
It leaves my face very moisturized for almost the entire day.
I have been using this product for a few weeks now and it is my new fave addition to my skincare routine. It has made my skin look and feel amazing. I would definitely recommend using this product.

avis.titre: Such a fun product to use!
avis.texte: I use this spray right after cleansing to provide extra hydration to my skin. I love the scent and the way the product dispenses on my skin. I also like the subtle glow it leaves on my skin, although I was expecting it to have a little bit more of a glow. I normally use this morning and night and it's such a unique product that I look forward to using it every day! I got the product for free in exchange for writing the review

This spray is amazing. Makes your skin feel so smoth and refreshed. The smell is not overpowering and best of all makes your skin feel so fresh and clean. Does not leave a residue and abosrbs quickly and efficiently. Definitely recommend

I love this spray. I first saw it in viral social posts saying it melts powder foundation into your skin. Absolutely does! It feels light but luxurious at the same time, definitely indulgent. The product is intended to be versatile - used as a serum, primer, setting spray or makeup refresher. While it can certainly be used in all of those applications, I found that it didn't work well enough to replace any of those products, so I found myself adding it to my skincare routine as a makeup melting spray, rather than replacing one of my existing products. I definitely enjoy it and think it's priced very reasonably, it just wish it was able to actually be used in place of one of my other products. Still would purchase again though!
It leaves your face very hydrated and helps with the makeup finish! I recommend

Wow great smell. Don't let the oil fool you. A few shakes spray and dry. I was weary whenI say the oil floating at the top. The smell is amazing, the glow and softness after using is absolutely wonderful. Definitely a great product

avis.titre: Not sure it does anything and it stains stuff
avis.texte: The positive: it feels nice and refreshing when you spray it on. The negatives: it is yellow and stains your clothing and the area around you when spraying it on. I have not noticed a change in my skin since I started using this. I have a few pimples popping up too, that I think are being caused by this spray.

I received this product from d'Alba to review and I'm glad I had the opportunity. On a regular day I probably would've skipped over this product simply because of the "white truffle". I imagined the product would probably be heavily scented. This product is moderately scented, not too strong but there is a scent when sprayed. However, this serum spray leaves such a hydrated glow after applying sunscreen especially for someone like me with dry combo skin, this would be heavenly during the winter!
Everytime I use this it leaves my skin looking polished and refreshed. It's hydrating and gives you an amazing glow on your skin. I would definitely recommend.

I've tried a lot of facial mists and serums, but the d'Alba White Truffle First Spray Serum really stands out because it feels more nourishing than typical sprays while still being lightweight and refreshing. It gives my skin an instant hydrated, dewy glow and works well both before and after makeup, which makes it super convenient for everyday use. One of the biggest benefits for me is how multi-functional it is—it simplifies my routine while still delivering visible results. I would definitely buy this product because it's become something I reach for daily, and I would absolutely recommend it to friends and family, especially anyone looking for an easy way to achieve healthy, glowing skin.

This spray is a new staple in my beauty routine. I use it to prep my skin before makeup and to blend in my concealer. The glow is so effortless and pretty !I appreciate the subtle fragrance and hydrating effects. Will definitely order more!
This misting serum is delightfully fragrant and very refreshing! It's light and cool as it mists. I would like to use to longer to see a real impact but using it in the winter has proven useful.
Really lovely serum that goes on smooth and doesn't leave sticky. Definitely gives a natural glow!!

I have been using the product daily the last 2 weeks and i love it! I have dry combo skin and this bi phase spray offers a lot of hydration to my skin without compromising setting well my makeup through out the day! Make sure you shake well before use. I use it between makeup layers and at the end for a glass skin! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! Really staple in my routine now!

I was offered the opportunity to try d'Alba's White Truffle First Spray Serum and I am so grateful that I was!! This product is legitimately incredible! It is simple to apply! It is soothing! It hydrates beautifully! It leaves my skin nourished and refreshed after just a couple spritzes! I put it on and I am literally glowing within 20 seconds of application! Not to mention the packaging is beautiful and the product itself smells heavenly! I honestly cannot say enough good things about this serum! I will definitely be buying it again and again! Love, Love, Love!!

Feels good on the skin, but really this is an extra unnecessary step. I've been using it for a while now and I haven't noticed any difference in my skin. It's very fragrant, not a bad smell, but something to be aware of if you're sensitive to fragrance. It feels nice on the skin, but doesn't do enough for me to want to purchase/recommend this.
This d'Alba White Truffle First Spray Serum feels so good on my face! I love that it comes in an easy to spray bottle instead of a dropper like most serums!

avis.titre: Glow On-the-Go: A Refreshing Mist for Radiant, Hydrated Skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love the d'Alba First Spray Serum—it's become a staple in my skincare routine. The lightweight mist feels incredibly refreshing and instantly gives my skin a hydrated, radiant glow without feeling greasy. I also appreciate how convenient and easy it is to use throughout the day, whether over makeup or on bare skin. Definitely a must-have if you're looking for a quick boost of hydration and glow!

I've been using this serum for the past few weeks and I love how lightweight it feels on my skin. Usually serums dry out my already very dry skin but this serum makes my skin look and feel hydrated. It sits so well under my makeup and gives my skin an instant glow. Just one spritz and I'm done. My makeup looks so much better over it as well. Highly recommend!

Okay this stuff is actually insane for glow!! I just mist it on, and my skin instantly looks dewy and fresh, not greasy at all. It's been perfect for achieving glass skin without doing a whole routine.

I have been using this serum for about 2 weeks now. The pros: good mist, lightweight serum, absorbs nicely, makes my skin feel plump and hydrated. The cons: spray is hard to tell if coverage is even Overall I really like this serum and would definitely purchase again. It compares better than my previous serum because it fully absorbs and doesn't feel sticky. It goes on nicely and my skin feels good and hydrated. I spray on and let it absorb before putting on any additional products. The spray takes a bit of getting use to so that you get an even coverage. I have been using daily and sometimes at night for about 3 weeks now. I was sent this product for my honest review.

This product is meant to be used as a hydrating spray, but I've been using it after applying make up to give it a dewy look. Others have mentioned that that online and it really works! The only downside is that the smell is a bit too strong for me. I do prefer lighter smells for reference.

I really wanted to love this because the concept is great, but it just didn't work for my skin. I expected it to feel super hydrating and refreshing, but instead it left my face feeling kind of dry and a little sticky. I used it on a clean, bare face with no makeup, and even then it didn't give that moisturized glow I was hoping for. Because of how it felt on its own, I can't see myself using it throughout the day or over makeup. Overall, I'd probably skip this in my routine.

avis.titre: High end hydration in a bottle
avis.texte: I recently started using the d'Alba White Truffle First Spray Serum and it has quickly become a favorite in my daily routine. I really love how the fine mist feels like a hydrating cloud rather than a heavy spray of water. It gives my skin an instant glow that looks healthy and dewy without feeling greasy or sticky on my face. I find myself reaching for it right after I wash my face to prevent any dryness or even over my makeup to refresh my look during the day. The scent is a light floral that feels very high-end and luxurious like a spa treatment. While it might be a bit much for someone with very oily skin, it works perfectly for my combination skin to keep it looking plump and radiant. It is easily the fastest way I have found to get that glass skin finish without needing a long and complicated skincare process.
